messages:
ana: Starting v2 canary now. Rolling gateway + runtime-v2. Initial target: 2% traffic in us-east. Watch p99 and global error rate. Rollback triggers: p99 > 400ms OR errors > 0.2% sustained for 10m. Release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/v2-canary-2026/notes
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary deploy 2501234567 -> v2. targets: gateway, proxy-shim, runtime-v2. canary_id=cb-2501. Canaries: 2% us-east. health-window=15m
liam: Copy. Dash link: https://dash.reports/redwood/canary/cb-2501
sasha: Heads-up: mobile SDKs default to v1. Suggest we hold mobile traffic at 0% for first 30m until we validate responses (mobile SDK <1.4 may 400).
tess: Can do. Applying client pin for mobile now. Also adding a header gate 'X-Client-Api-Version' for opt-in.
nana: (typo)
nana: ignore that
ana: (oops)
ana: ack tess
tess: Done. Applied client-pin: mobile=pin_v1 until 2026-03-20T20:00Z. Header gate note in docs. Example: `curl -H 'X-Client-Api-Version: 2' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/`
mike: Quick reminder: SDKs older than 1.4 send the old payload shape. We have a strict schema check that will 400 unknown fields. Good call to pin mobile.
sasha: Also set monitors: p50/p95/p99, global error rate, and model-fallback-count. Automated rollback conditions configured: >0.2% errors OR p99 > 400ms for 10 minutes. Alerting to #oncall and paging to infra if triggered.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rolling at 2%. health check window started (15m).
liam: If green at 30m, plan: increase to 10% then to 50% over next 24h. We'll post a changelog blurb and notify enterprise leads.
nana: (typo)
nana: sorry
nana: I'll draft RN
nana: actually ana here: I'll draft the release-notes blurb on header gating and mobile pin.
tess: Draft ready: "v2 introduces header-gated opt-in. Mobile SDKs <1.4 will not opt in by default; see migration guide."
ops-bot: ops-bot: detected spike: proxy-shim us-east-1-proxy-2 returned 500s at t+7m. count=12. Investigating.
mike: I see the 500s correlate with long-tail kernel compile on one runtime shard. Applying fallback kernel and restarting that worker on canary hosts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: patch rollforward applied to canary hosts. Re-evaluating metrics now.
liam: Metrics leveling out. p99 down to ~210ms, error rate 0.03%. Looks good from infra side.
nana: (typo)
nana: thanks
ana: :thumbsup:
sasha: Keep mobile pin for another 60m then reassess. Also add a note for sales: don't flip enterprise tenants until dedicated toggles are set. I'll add to the release checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary health window completed at 35m. Recommendation: increase to 10% APPROVED by owners (ana, liam, sasha).
ana: increasing to 10% now. Keep same rollback thresholds. If anything spikes, abort and pin back to v1.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scaling canary to 10% (traffic-shift). ETA ~3m.
tess: Release notes updated: https://go/redwood/releases/v2-canary-2026/notes
sasha: Final: automated PIN-back job created — if we rollback, mobile pin remains until manual review.
liam: Thanks team. I'll post a summary in #releases later and close thread after 3h stable.
